lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters located posterior to the gill slits, displaying a semi-regular grid arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows to create a series of grid-like nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features running horizontally along the upper flank, defined by a distinct brightness gradient with highlights on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a dense population of smaller, lower-contrast luminance blobs concentrated along its leading edge and dorsal surface.
